name: Camping 101: Herbalism

angles.text: As an herbalist, you learn to make incense candles from gathered plants for use at wilderness camps.
As a cook, you learn to kindle the campfire at the heart of every camp.

faq.answer: Herbalists craft incense candles from wild plants. Burn one at a wilderness campsite beside a campfire.
You can set up camp in the open wilderness. Townsfolk object to tents spread across town thoroughfares.
faq.q: Where can you set up a camp?

faq.answer: A camp needs a campfire at its heart. Cooking trainers across Azeroth teach basic fire-building techniques.
faq.q: Why do you need a campfire to set up a camp?

faq.answer: Cooking trainers teach you to kindle a simple campfire. Learn the basics of cooking before you head into the wild.
faq.q: Who teaches how to make a campfire?

aliases: what does herbalism give for camps
faq.answer: Herbalism provides the plants and resins for incense candles. Gathered from the wilds, they bring soothing aromas to your campsite.
faq.q: How does herbalism tie into camping?

aliases: can i light incense candle without fire
faq.answer: A camp needs a proper campfire. Set one before you settle in to use an incense candle.
faq.q: Do you need a campfire to use an incense candle?

sections.body: Herbalism lets you turn gathered plants into incense candles for comfort on the trail. Townsfolk frown on tents pitched in city streets, so these candles are meant for camps beyond guarded settlements.
sections.title: Aromatic Craft of the Wild

sections.body: A campfire belongs at the heart of every campsite. Set one before you use an incense candle. Herbalists provide the aromatic burn, while cooking trainers across the land teach travelers the basics of starting a fire.
sections.title: The Heart of the Campsite

summary: You learn to make incense candles from wild plants in Camping 101: Herbalism. First, though, a proper camp needs a fire, and your campsite belongs in the wilderness beyond town.
